title: Sandbar Notebook | Checking the field edition
titleZh: 沙洲筆記｜外勤版驗收備忘
passage:
Field teams carry printed sheets with a short link for each entry in Sandbar Notebook. Keep an entry’s original link when replacing its text if the new text still serves the purpose for which the sheet was printed. An old link can instead redirect to an index page, but only if the field team can tell which entry to open next without searching. Do not redirect a printed link directly to a different procedure merely because the new procedure has a similar name.

The same short link is on two printed sheets. The field sheet says ‘Check the first connection after switching power sources’; the workshop sheet says ‘Test a returned unit on the bench.’ We now have one page for confirming whether a reader connects in the field, and one for testing a returned reader on the bench. The crew must open the field instructions to find out whether a reader has connected. The draft index currently lists two links both titled ‘Connection Check.’

The export button gathers entries and pictures already saved on the device; it does not download missing files. It can reuse a full picture saved under another entry if both point to the same original picture ID. A preview badge shows only that the small version has been saved. A full-copy badge confirms a full picture for the ID shown alongside the badge. If an entry has no picture, saving the text is enough.

Inez has saved the text of all three entries for the trip. Reader Setup needs picture R17. It shows only a preview, but the unrelated Workshop Kit entry already has a full-copy badge for picture R17. Cable Labels needs picture C24. A full-size picture of the old set, C19, is still saved, and C24 has only a preview. Hand Signals has no picture. The team needs full pictures of every illustration referenced by the three selected entries, but has no need for the old label set.
passageZh:
外勤小組攜帶印有短網址的紙本，每個短網址對應沙洲筆記的一個條目。更換條目內容時，如果新內容仍符合當初印製紙本的用途，就保留原網址。舊網址也可以重新導向索引頁，但前提是外勤小組不用搜尋就能知道接下來應開啟哪個條目。不要只因為名稱相似，就把紙本上的網址直接導向另一個流程。

兩種紙本使用同一個短網址。外勤紙本寫的是「切換電源後，檢查第一次連線」；工作間紙本則寫「在工作台測試送回的設備」。現在我們分成一頁說明如何在外勤確認讀取器是否連線，另一頁說明如何在工作台測試送回的讀取器。外勤小組得開啟外勤說明，才知道怎麼確認讀取器有沒有連線。索引草稿目前有兩個連結，都叫〈連線檢查〉。

匯出按鈕會收集裝置上已儲存的條目及圖片，不會下載缺少的檔案。兩個條目若指向相同的原始圖片 ID，可共用另一條目已存好的完整圖片。預覽標記只表示儲存了小圖。完整副本標記則確認標記旁所列的 ID 有完整圖片。條目若沒有圖片，儲存文字就可以。

伊內絲已儲存此行三個選定條目的文字。〈讀取器設定〉需要圖片 R17；該條目只有預覽，不過另一個不在此次清單內的〈工作間套件〉已有 R17 的完整副本標記。〈線材標籤〉需要圖片 C24；舊版標籤圖片 C19 的完整圖還在，但 C24 只有預覽。〈手勢〉沒有圖片。小組需要三個選定條目所引用的完整圖片，不需要舊版標籤。
